title: 教育之辩
text: 今天的太阳格外明亮。阳光照进教室，学生们正低头阅读。当前的教育改革引发了广泛讨论。许多人主张改变传统教学模式。他们认为死记硬背缺乏效率。这种观点之所以盛行，是因为现代社会需要综合能力。单纯追求高分无法应对复杂挑战。教师的角色应当从传授者变为引导者。学习目标应转向培养独立思考。然而，部分人士持有不同看法。他们强调基础知识的重要性。缺乏扎实根基会导致认知浅薄。这种坚持之所以存在，是因为基础决定了学术上限。两者之间的矛盾难以迅速调和。评价体系的滞后成了最大障碍。如果考试形式不变，改革就很难深入。我们需要一种更科学的衡量方式。多样化的考核能挖掘潜在天赋。教育不应是单一的模具。它应该是引导个体成长的过程。社会应当给予学校更多空间。只有打破旧思维，才能迎来新局面。这场争论反映了时代的焦虑。我们必须寻找一个平衡点。让知识与能力同步提升。

questions.prompt: Why do reform advocates believe rote memorization is inefficient?
options: Because modern society requires comprehensive abilities beyond high test scores
Because it takes too much classroom time
Because students find it boring
Because it is more expensive than other methods

questions.prompt: According to reform advocates, how should the teacher's role change?
options: From a transmitter of knowledge to a guide
From a guide to a strict disciplinarian
Teachers should be replaced by textbooks
Teachers should focus solely on test preparation

questions.prompt: What do those who emphasize foundational knowledge argue?
options: Lacking a solid foundation leads to shallow understanding, since it determines the academic ceiling
Foundational knowledge is no longer necessary
Only creative thinking matters, not facts
Testing should be abolished entirely

questions.prompt: What does the text identify as the biggest obstacle to reform?
options: The lagging, outdated evaluation (exam) system
Lack of school funding
Teacher shortages
Parental opposition

questions.prompt: What does the text suggest is needed to resolve the debate?
options: A more scientific, diversified assessment method that balances both views
Complete abolition of all exams
A full return to traditional rote learning
Letting only test scores decide everything

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 如果…就…
patterns.explanation: "If X, then Y." The most common conditional. 如果 can be replaced with 要是 or 假如.
patterns.example_translation: If you have time, come over.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
